_notes.provenance_note: Poplar scans from the CLS collaboration between Thorsten Knipfer and Mina Momayyezi; per Knipfer's email (Thu Jun 25, addressed to Lawren, Christine, Elizabeth, Santiago Trueba, Craig, Adam, Dula, Guillaume, Richard Harwood), if these scans are included in the manuscript dataset he should be added as a co-author.
_notes.encoding: Distinct 7-value scheme for this specimen, not the Devin-standard scheme used by poplar_1/poplar_b4f_3gil; values confirmed against mask geometry and user-provided crop, not a written legend
_notes.value_100_130: Adaxial_Epidermis (100, top band) + Abaxial_Epidermis (130, bottom band) → Epidermis (class 1); user-confirmed as two separate top/bottom bands
_notes.value_75_220: Bundle_Sheath (75, outer ring around a vein) + Vascular_Tissue (220, inner core of a vein) → Vascular_Region (class 2); user-confirmed from an annotated vein cross-section crop (220 = inside, 75 = boundary outside)
_notes.value_0: Mesophyll (class 3); user-confirmed (initially guessed as Air_Space, corrected by user)
_notes.value_255: Air_Space (class 4); user-confirmed (initially guessed as Mesophyll, corrected by user)
_notes.mask_check: Verified mask pixel values across all 6 slices = {0, 75, 100, 130, 170, 220, 255}, image size 2034x408 (L mode)
_notes.facility_beamline: Canadian Light Source, Biomedical Imaging and Therapy - Bending Magnet (BMIT-BM 05B1)
_notes.detector: PCO Edge 5.5 sCMOS with LSO:Tb scintillator (10 um)
